_readme: One real response per endpoint from the Pulso mock API. Request = the 'request' field; body = 'response'. Numbers are invented; shapes are final.

response.note: MOCK DATA — invented numbers with the real response shapes. Do not quote as findings.

whatif.note: Computed in the browser: for N moved trips, trips[to[i]] += 1 and trips[from[i]] -= 1 for i < N; places_offered = trips × vehicle.places; load_factor = est_peak_load / places_offered.

response.method: A transfer = two entry taps by the same card within 60 minutes on different operators. Wait = minutes between the first leg's estimated arrival and the next tap.
Expected = median of the same stop and hour on the other weekdays. Flag when the robust z-score (median absolute deviation) exceeds 3.5.
